P_0x00ACD1.en:
A key member of the <SRX Project>.
A superb engineer, one of the creators of the <Personal Trooper>. A cold perfectionist who gets along with Robert, his opposite. Once wed to Marion.

P_0x00AFAC.en: The central figure of the <ATX Project>. A brilliant scientist, but a workaholic, egotistical, and jealous. Developed the Alt Eisen and Weiss Ritter; now at <Mao Industries> on a prototype.

P_0x00B0FB.en: Director of the <Tesla Leicht Institute>. Irm's father and Robert's former boss. A robotics authority rivaling the late Bian Zoldark. Easygoing, fond of jokes and women. Creator of the Grungust series.

P_0x00C240.en: Former president of <Earth Fed Gov't>. Once led the Colony Integ. Army over ten colonies. Capable, peace-loving politician.

P_0x00CC05.en: President of the <Earth Fed Gov't>. A hawk for resistance vs. aliens; nicknamed "the Wizard" for looks and backroom skill.

P_0x00CCE5.en: President of <Isurugi Heavy Ind.> Daughter of former president Renji Isurugi, who died in the <L5 Campaign>. A gentle beauty in manner, but shrewd. Puts profit first; picky about neither methods nor partners.

P_0x00CFED.en: A brilliant scientist once of <EOTI Organization>, now developing weapons for the Zentl Project. Also a Granzon designer.

P_0x00D2D6.en:
Cheerful, flashy, wild-looking but easygoing, loves music above all. Garnet's boyfriend, but can't win an argument with her.
After <L5 Campaign> he left the army and married her.
